releases.notes:
### Changed
- **Updated to Minecraft 26.3.** A single jar now covers all of 26.3.x. The build pins to the
  26.3 floor and the released jar declares `~26.3`, so it loads on every 26.3 patch.
- Bumped Fabric API to `0.160.6+26.3` and Fabric Loader to `0.19.5`.

### Notes
- 26.2.x users should stay on 1.2.0; 1.3.0 targets the 26.3 series.
- All gametests pass against the official 26.3 release on a headless server.

releases.notes:
### Changed
- **Updated to Minecraft 26.2.** A single jar now covers all of 26.2.x. The build pins to the
  26.2 floor and the released jar declares `~26.2`, so it loads on every 26.2 patch.
- Bumped Fabric API to `0.152.1+26.2` and Fabric Loom to `1.17-SNAPSHOT`.
- Raised the Gradle wrapper to `9.5.0`, which Loom 1.17 requires.

### Notes
- 26.1.x users should stay on 1.1.0; 1.2.0 targets the 26.2 series.
- All gametests pass against the official 26.2 release on a headless server.



## What's Changed
